theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.heckeWedderburn_symm_single {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (n : ℕ) (lam : (n + 1).Partition) (T : Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau (Mathlib.partitionShape lam)) :
(heckeWedderburn q hq0 hq2 n).symm (Pi.single lam (Matrix.single T T 1)) = jmProjIn q (Hecke.σ K q q⁻¹ n) (contentVec T)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.JMProjector.heckeProduct_jmProj {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (n : ℕ) (lam : (n + 1).Partition) (T : Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau (Mathlib.partitionShape lam)) :
(heckeProduct q hq0 hq2 n) (jmProjIn q (Hecke.σ K q q⁻¹ n) (contentVec T)) = Pi.single lam (Matrix.single T T 1)
